title: Korea Investment Savings Bank says personal data of 86,433 customers leaked after abnormal access to its mobile website
date_note: Date the bank posted its notice, as reported by Asia Economy on 25 November.
summary: Asia Economy reports that Korea Investment Savings Bank posted a notice on 24 November saying personal data of 86,433 customers leaked. The bank says abnormal external access to its mobile website ran from 10:42 pm on 22 November to 3:35 am on 23 November, and it found it during a system inspection on 23 November. It says names, birth dates, gender, phone numbers and CI were exposed, but not account passwords or financial transaction data.
plain: Korea Investment Savings Bank says the personal data of 86,433 customers leaked after abnormal access to its mobile website. It says account passwords and transaction data were not leaked.
exec: The bank says 86,433 customers' personal data leaked; it says passwords and transaction data were not.
action: No action needed; for awareness. The bank says it blocked the IP address and access route and suspended related services.
geo_basis: country; city not stated in the source

validation.note: Only Asia Economy read (quoting the bank's 24 November notice); the bank's notice was not read.
